question_cn: 2026世界杯小组赛L组：英格兰 vs 克罗地亚，90分钟三路赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group L: England vs Croatia, 90-minute three-way result?
one_liner_cn: 英格兰Elo高出克罗地亚约112分且热身连胜、阵容齐整，克罗地亚核心老化带伤、热身疲软，英格兰约52%胜率，平局与克胜各约24%。
one_liner_en: England's ~112-point Elo edge, unbeaten warm-ups and intact squad against an aging, injury-hampered Croatia put England at ~52%, with draw and Croatia win at ~24% each.

key_reasons.cn: Elo差距明显：英格兰2024（第4）vs 克罗地亚1912（第12），Davidson基线已给英格兰约49%。
key_reasons.en: Clear Elo gap: England 2024 (4th) vs Croatia 1912 (12th); the Davidson baseline already gives England about 49%.

key_reasons.cn: 克罗地亚核心老化且带伤：莫德里奇40岁（4月颧骨骨折）、格瓦迪奥尔胫骨骨折刚恢复、科瓦契奇赛季饱受跟腱伤困扰。
key_reasons.en: Croatia's core is aging and carrying injuries: Modric, 40, after an April cheekbone fracture; Gvardiol just back from a fractured tibia; Kovacic troubled by Achilles problems most of the season.

key_reasons.cn: 热身赛走势相反：英格兰1-0新西兰、3-0哥斯达黎加；克罗地亚0-2负比利时、2-1险胜斯洛文尼亚。
key_reasons.en: Opposite warm-up trajectories: England beat New Zealand 1-0 and Costa Rica 3-0; Croatia lost 0-2 to Belgium and edged Slovenia 2-1.

method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net 2026-06-11) Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) -> p_stat ENG 49.2/draw 25.0/CRO 25.8; bounded evidence adjustment +3.0/-1.0/-2.0pp (England form & squad availability vs Croatia injuries & weak friendlies, capped by Croatia's tournament resilience) -> p_final 52.2/24.0/23.8. No betting or prediction-market data used.
